verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product. Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is not a fair axis for comparing law firms. Its data-privacy practice advises clients on privacy law; it is not a user-facing tracking control, so the axis stays inapplicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
